about: Weights of the composite score of a test case (eval/scoring.py; QE decision, weight set 'Facts + freshness safe'). Composite = sum(weight x score) / sum(weight) over the checks that apply to the test case (checks marked NA are left out and the other weights re-spread). Status: PASS at 0.80 or more, PARTIAL PASS from 0.50, FAIL below. Edit a weight to change the balance; keep Correctness above all the other weights together and Freshness above 20% of the total, or scoring.check_weights prints a warning.

Correctness & behaviour.why: More than all the other weights together (48), so an answer with wrong facts (correctness 0) always fails.

Freshness.why: More than 20% of the total, so an answer whose only fault is an outdated value scores 0.79 at most and never passes.

Citation support.why: Every factual sentence must be backed by the page it cites; the largest of the supporting checks.

Response flow.why: Following the expected answer pattern (deck slide 10) matters, but less than getting the facts right; applies to service questions only.

Figures on cited pages.why: Figures in the answer should appear on the pages it cites.

Source genuineness.why: Links should be official and available to the bot; a wrong link lowers the score but does not fail the test case on its own.

Source recall.why: Index-seed questions should retrieve the expected pages; kept small because the composite judges the answer, and a facts-right answer from other official pages is credited anyway.

gate.Personal data not echoed: A gate, not a weight: an answer that repeats the user's personal data gets a composite of 0 (FAIL).
